text:
[RFCS.1.2] An event trace is read two ways.

- **Replay** re-executes the trace against a DS engine and compares what the
  engine produces with what the trace holds ([LFST.9]). It is the determinism
  check, and the only reading that requires the compiled program ([LDET.2.6]).
- **Inspection** reads the trace without an engine. Every schema is announced
  before its first use ([LFST.8.10]), so a tool decodes every event from the
  trace itself and needs neither engine nor artefact.

Debugging is not a third reading. A debugger drives replay with interactive
control ([LDEB.10.7], [LDEB.8.7]).
